name: Articles and Determiners
description: The definite, indefinite and zero article, plus quantifiers and determiners such as some, any, much, many, few, little and each.

questions.title: I bought ___ umbrella yesterday because the forecast looked bad.
Kyiv is ___ capital of Ukraine.
My sister plays ___ piano beautifully.
We had ___ breakfast at seven and left the house at eight.
She works as ___ engineer for a construction company.
Which noun normally takes no article when we speak about it in general?
There is ___ milk in the fridge, but not very much.
Have you got ___ questions about the homework?
How ___ people were there at the concert?
We haven't got ___ time before the train leaves.
___ Carpathians are popular with hikers all year round.
He is ___ honest man, so everyone trusts him.
I need ___ new pair of trainers for the gym.
Which article is used when the listener already knows which thing we mean?
Match each noun with the article that goes before it.
Match each quantifier with the noun type it goes with.
pairs: countable plural nouns with a positive sense
uncountable nouns with a positive sense

questions.title: Match each place expression with its correct article use.
pairs: no article, because the purpose is what matters
the definite article, because the building is meant
no article for the familiar routine
the definite article for a physical position

questions.title: Match each noun with the category it belongs to.
pairs: uncountable, so it has no plural form
countable, so it takes a plural

questions.title: There were ___ visitors that the guides had to open a second entrance.
___ of the two applicants had the required experience.
He gave ___ explanation that nobody understood a word.
Which sentence uses the zero article correctly?
options: Life in big cities can be stressful.
The life in big cities can be stressful in general.
A life in big cities can be stressful in general.
Life in the big cities in general can be stressful.

questions.title: Very ___ students managed to answer the last question, which surprised the examiner.
___ information you gave me turned out to be extremely useful.
Each of the candidates ___ asked the same three questions.
Which sentence about articles contains a mistake?
options: She plays the tennis every Sunday.
She plays the violin every Sunday.
She goes to the tennis club every Sunday.

questions.title: There is hardly ___ evidence to support that claim.
We spent ___ two hours waiting at the border.
___ the students in my group speaks at least two foreign languages.
The exhibition was ___ success that it was extended by a month.
I have read ___ of his novels, but not all of them.
Match each determiner with the sentence it completes correctly.
pairs: Both roads lead to the station.
Either road will take you there.

questions.title: Match each phrase with the meaning the article gives it.
pairs: inside the building for any reason

questions.title: Match each quantifier with the shade of meaning it carries.
Match each sentence with the reason for the article that is used.
pairs: I saw a fox in the garden.
The fox came back the next night.
Foxes are common in this area.
a general statement about a species

questions.title: Match each faulty phrase with the reason it is wrong.
pairs: an uncountable noun cannot take an indefinite article
much is used with uncountable nouns
the quantifier does not take the before most
every is followed by a singular noun

questions.title: ___ number of applications has risen sharply this year.
Which sentence uses the definite article for a generic class in formal writing?
options: The smartphone has transformed the way people communicate.
A smartphone has transformed the way people communicate in general.

questions.title: Only a small proportion of the funding ___ actually reached the schools.
He was appointed ___ head of the department last spring.
Which sentence correctly uses 'the' with a superlative and a defining phrase?
options: It is the most convincing argument I have heard this year.
It is most convincing argument I have heard this year.
It is a most convincing argument I have heard this year.
It is the most convincing argument what I have heard.

questions.title: ___ great deal of research remains to be done in this field.
Match each formal quantifying phrase with its plain equivalent.
Match each noun phrase with the meaning the article choice creates.
Match each subject with the verb form the determiner requires.
